lines.t: Yet look how easily a little child passes through
Men and women of this world, you stand too tall
Lose this height therefore and bow down
As fatted cattle you have become meet for the slaughter
Refuse all this rotten food fed to the masses
And eat no more from the filthy plates served in the churches of men
Rather partake of the food I give you, and be satisfied
For I tell you the truth
Until you decrease in the world’s eyes
And are humbled in your own
You shall by no means pass through
For the first harvest shall be lowly
Of the lowly, says The Lord
